[c01] Internal policy — Escalation procedure. Tickets marked Urgent must be acknowledged within 4 minutes and assigned to a named team lead. High priority tickets have a 46-hour resolution target. If a ticket breaches its target, it is automatically escalated to the duty manager and a breach note is added. Customers are not informed about internal escalation levels. Follow-up reminders are generated automatically by the system. Internal reference codes were verified by the handling agent.

[c02] Internal policy — Warranty policy. All electronics carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty starting from the delivery date. Warranty claims require the order number and a short description of the fault. Approved claims receive a replacement unit shipped within 24 business days; denied claims receive a written explanation. Accidental damage and liquid ingress are not covered. A satisfaction survey was sent after the case was closed. The customer confirmed receipt of the notification message.

[c03] Internal policy — Returns process. Customers start a return from the order page and print the prepaid label. Items must be shipped back within 8 days of the return approval. The warehouse inspects the item within 4 business days of arrival and the refund timeline starts after the inspection is complete. Escalation was not required for this case. All timestamps are recorded in Riyadh local time.
